page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance configured for compute-intensive workloads and artificial intelligence processing. The server is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9555 processor operating at 2.0 GHz, providing 16 shared vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with one thread per core. The host platform supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. System memory totals 80.0 GB, allocating 5.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU from the Blackwell family equipped with 96 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this configuration, requiring attached network volumes for persistent data. The instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks show exceptional single-core CPU execution and memory throughput. The instance achieves top-decile results in Geekbench single-core testing at 2665.0 points and stress-ng single-core operations, alongside high uncached read bandwidth of 444.94 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 279.59 GB/sec. Multi-core performance registers in the top 25 percent for Geekbench multi-core at 19858.0 points and bzip3 decompression at 283.91 GB/sec, while overall PassMark CPU scores remain in the median tier. The integrated NVIDIA Blackwell GPU provides top-tier large language model inference speed, processing 8554.23 prompt tokens per second and generating 234.73 tokens per second on 7B parameter models, with similar top-decile throughput on smaller architectures.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server combines substantial dedicated GPU memory with a moderate 16-core shared CPU footprint, minimizing CPU overhead while providing high VRAM capacity for memory-heavy models. The lack of local disk storage means disk input and output will depend entirely on network storage configurations. This hardware configuration is best suited for machine learning inference, deep learning model fine-tuning, image processing pipelines, high-throughput text processing, and batch compute jobs requiring hardware acceleration.
description: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for machine learning inference and parallel computing. Built on the KVM hypervisor, it features 16 shared vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9555 processor at 2.0 GHz, 80.0 GB of system memory, and a dedicated NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU featuring 96 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, relying on external network storage solutions. In benchmark testing, the platform demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, top-tier uncached memory bandwidth exceeding 444 GB/sec, and top-tier LLM inference execution reaching 8554.23 prompt tokens per second on 7B models. The balanced core count paired with high GPU memory density delivers strong resource efficiency for specialized workloads. The instance is suited for AI model serving, image and text processing pipelines, data transformation, and GPU-assisted analytical tasks.
